title: Bicalutamide: daily anti-androgen tablets
context_label: Advanced prostate cancer with ADT or surgical castration
indication_text: Advanced prostate cancer with LHRH analogue therapy or surgical castration.
purpose: Block the androgen receptor to help control advanced prostate cancer alongside testosterone suppression.
schedule_label: One tablet daily; no planned rest week
schedule_summary: Take bicalutamide 50 mg once daily continuously with an LHRH analogue, or after surgical castration. A 28-day display is a review window, not a treatment break.
administration_text: Swallow the tablet whole at approximately the same time each day, with or without food. Do not chew, split or crush it. If a dose is missed or vomited, take only the next scheduled dose; do not take an extra tablet.
monitoring_summary: Repeat blood count, kidney and liver tests and glucose when clinically indicated. Periodic liver tests are particularly relevant in the first six months. Warfarin or other coumarin treatment needs close INR monitoring.

agents.name: Bicalutamide 50 mg
agents.mechanism: Bicalutamide binds to the androgen receptor, preventing androgens from switching on growth signals. The 50 mg NCCP service combines receptor blockade with reduced testosterone from an LHRH analogue or surgery.
agents.explanation: Bicalutamide binds to the androgen receptor, preventing androgens from switching on growth signals. The 50 mg NCCP service combines receptor blockade with reduced testosterone from an LHRH analogue or surgery.
agents.watch: Tell the team about yellow eyes or skin, dark urine, worsening breathlessness or unusual bleeding. Use effective contraception during treatment and for 130 days afterwards. Do not stop or alter blood thinners yourself.
risks: Hot flushes, tiredness, dizziness and changes in mood
Breast swelling or tenderness; reduced sex drive or erection difficulties
Nausea, abdominal discomfort, constipation or diarrhoea
Liver inflammation or severe liver injury, rarely fatal
Blood in urine, anaemia or increased bleeding with coumarin anticoagulants
Heart-rhythm and cardiovascular effects, particularly with other ADT
Rash, photosensitivity or a serious allergic reaction
Uncommon inflammation of the lungs with cough or breathlessness

evidence.title: What the evidence can tell you
evidence.intro: Trial results describe groups of people; they cannot predict an individual outcome.
evidence.population: Advanced prostate cancer with LHRH analogue therapy or surgical castration.
evidence.comparison: Disease setting determines the relevant treatment comparison
evidence.interpretation: This established 50 mg combined-blockade service must not be treated as interchangeable with modern ARPI intensification. Benefits depend on the disease setting and overall treatment plan.
limitations: Response and progression endpoints are not the same as overall survival.
Trials do not predict the benefit or side effects for one individual.
